label: RunPod Video Generation
description: Generate a video clip on your own RunPod serverless endpoint. The worker's input schema is yours — Genlock passes `input` through unchanged.

endpoint_id.label: Endpoint ID
endpoint_id.description: RunPod serverless endpoint id (from the RunPod cockpit or console).

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Motion-first video prompt. Cue dialogue/SFX inline, never music (Sound Rule).

input.label: Worker Input (JSON)
input.description: Extra worker-specific input fields, passed through verbatim as the job's `input` object.

start_image.label: Start Image
start_image.description: Start frame path/URL if the worker supports image conditioning.

end_image.label: End Image
end_image.description: End frame path/URL if the worker supports it.

duration.label: Duration (s)
duration.description: Clip length if the worker supports it.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: RunPod endpoints run the USER'S OWN video worker — resolve its input schema before writing `input`. Video craft rules still apply: motion-first prompts, camera movement, pacing; cue dialogue and sound effects inline; never prompt for music. Local file paths in start_image/end_image only work if the worker accepts URLs or the caller uploads them — confirm the worker's conditioning contract first.
do: Set endpoint_id once at metadata.bones and inherit it
Apply frame chaining: shot N endFrameImage → shot N+1 start_image when action is continuous
Write results back via Quick Ingest (_inbox) with provider: "runpod" and assignment: "videoTake"
dont: Store the API key in any project file

x-genlock-surface.tagline: Patch a discovered video worker into the production with its references, timing, and exact input contract intact.
